content.title: Wells Fargo Recruits $1.2 Billion Advisory Team From Citigroup
content.summary: Wells Fargo  has recruited an advisory duo in Texas managing $1.2 billion in client assets.  Paul Cooke and Jake Trousdale have joined Wells Fargo’s Private Client Group in Dallas.  The move comes amid a reorganization within  Citigroup  that will see a new CFO take over in March and the firm’s retail banking operations be consolidated and organized within the wealth business, headed by Andy Sieg.

content.title: Financial Stocks Poised for Record as JPMorgan Nears Milestone Closing Price
content.summary: The S&P 500’s financials sector was on track for a record closing high on Monday as investors appeared to find more opportunities than risk in the wake of the Trump administration’s intervention in Venezuela.  JPMorgan Chase, the largest U.S. lender by assets and the second-largest component of the financials sector index after Warren Buffett’s Berkshire Hathaway, jumped 3.3%.  Jamie Dimon’s JPMorgan was on pace to close above a market cap of $900 billion for the first time on record, according to Dow Jones Market Data.
